Think a top 3 spot on Google costs too much to chase?

Do the maths backwards.
What does one job pay you?
How many extra jobs a month would cover what you spend getting there?

If the answer is one or two, chase the spot.

Picture this. You spend three hours on YouTube trying to fix a leaking tap.

Still dripping.

A plumber fixes it in ten minutes. AUD$180.

Expertise has actual value. Because it's hard to get.

Same goes for your Google Ads account.

Bathroom renovator in Wanneroo asks if he'll have to dance on TikTok to get more work.

No.

Show up on Google when locals search.
Stay in front of them on Facebook and Instagram until they book.

(No dancing required.)
